classification.difficultyReason: Identify the requested vertical height as opposite the given angle and multiply the string length by sine.

content.prompt:
A kite string is 55 m long and is fully extended.
The string makes an angle of $64^{\circ}$ with the ground.
Calculate how high above the ground it is to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Kite above right of the ground endpoint, oblique string, dashed vertical height and right-angle marker. Three dedicated labelling regions remain editable through the native diagram.
spec.mathematics: String is the hypotenuse and height is opposite the ground angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Ground and a degree symbol are supplied; string length, height and angle responses remain blank.

answer.worked:
Label the string $55\text{ m}$, the ground angle $64^{\circ}$ and the vertical height $h$.
$$\begin{aligned}\sin64^{\circ}&=\frac{h}{55}\\55\sin64^{\circ}&=h\\h&\approx49.4\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Completed mathematical triangle with string length, ground angle and unknown vertical height.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 55 m, angle 64 degrees and opposite side h.
